name: agent-token-manager
description: Research and measure coding-agent context cost with privacy-safe audit and budgeted navigation.

interface.shortDescription: Audit agent context cost and navigation.
interface.longDescription: A completed research prototype for privacy-safe tool-output measurement, auditable context-intervention experiments, and feedback-driven source navigation under hard token budgets. It does not claim production-wide token savings.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my observed tool-result payloads and explain the measurement limits.
